blocks.text:
Feature:
 Modern design for your modern life
 Easy to move due to its material(Rattan) is light
 Easy to assemble with the complete tools and instructions
 Excellent manufacture technology make the chairs looks very well
 Soft cushions can offer a comfortable sitting experience to you when you sit on it
 Anti rust and anti-corrosion treatment make the chair has longer service life
 Rattan wicker has outstanding sturdy to stand your weight and the material looks like very smooth
 It can be widely used in differnt scenarios such as can use it to have a nice chat with your firends in your beautiful garden or quiet porch

Specification:
 Color: Brown and Beige
 Material: Rattan wicker and glass
 Package Dimensions: 26.6"(L) x 12.1"(W) x 19.3"(H)
 Weight: 42 lbs

Package includes:
 A tool kit
 Two single seats
 A glass rattan table
 A manual of installation and usage
Notice: There may be some differences between the photos and products in terms of color due to the influence of the lighting during the process of shooting or the settings of display screen

items.label: Comfortable&Convenient
items.value: The sturdy rattan equipped with the soft cushion can offer you a perfect using experience. And the rattan is light, so the set whole weight is also light, you can move it to any suitable place easily.

items.label: Friendly Design
items.value: Soft cushion, spacious seat, strong chair frame and light material construct an user friendly design. It’s fashion due to its look and light material-Rattan. It’s comfortable due to its soft cushion and suitable backrest.

items.label: Widely used
items.value: The item includes 2 single seats and a glass table, you can use it to have a chat with you family in garden or put it in porch. ALL in all, it is suitable for you to decorate the yard and not takes up a lot of space.

items.label: Sturdy&Durable
items.value: The chair set adopts high quality rattan wicker which can face all weather because the rattan had been treated with anti rust and anti-corrosion, these reasons ensure its longer service life.

items.label: Assemble Easily
items.value: Complete installation instruction and complete tool kit can make you assemble it easily with out any difficult.

items.label: Item Type Name
items.value: 3 Pieces Outdoor Patio Furniture Sets, PE Rattan Wicker Chair Conversation Sets with Soft Cushion and Glass Coffee Table for Garden Backyard Porch Poolside
